mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment(video_id, user_id, parent_id, content, is_deleted) VALUES (#{videoId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.user_id AS userId, c.content AS content, u.nickname AS nickname, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.is_deleted AS isDeleted FROM comment c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId}

SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.user_id AS userId, c.content AS content, u.nickname AS nickname, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.is_deleted AS isDeleted FROM comment c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.video_id = #{videoId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE video_id = #{videoId} AND parent_id IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
